spans.s: An aim or mark for arrows.
The feathered end of an arrow.

The body (शरीर); ते प्रकाश्याभिवदन्ति वयमेतद्बाणमवष्टभ्य
 विधारयामः Praśna.
N. of a demon, son of Bali; cf. उषा.

N. of a celebrated poet who lived at the court of king Harṣavardhana
 and flourished in the first half of the seventh century; (see App. II).
 He is the author of कादम्बरी, हर्षचरित and of some other works;
 (Govardhana in his Āryā.

speaks in these terms of Bāṇa:−
 जाता शिखण्डिनी प्राग् यथा शिखण्डी तथावगच्छामि । प्रागल्भ्यधिकमाप्तुं
 वाणी बाणो बभूवेति ॥; so हृदयवसतिः पञ्चबाणस्तु बाणः P.
A symbolical expression for the number ‘five’.
The versed sine of an arc.

. ˚यन्त्रम् a kind of bow with a mechanical contrivance
 at one of its ends for tightening the string and letting off the arrow;
a series of five verses forming one sentence.
a series of five verses forming one sentence.

+ -गङ्गा N. of a river said to have been produced by Rāvaṇaʼs
 arrow; सोमेशाद् दक्षिणे भागे वाणेनाभिविभिद्य वै । रावणेन प्रकटिता
 जलधारातिपुण्यदा । वाणगङ्गेति विख्याता या स्नानादघहारिणी ॥ Varāha P.
+ -गोचरः the range of an arrow; अवतीर्णोऽसि रतिरमणबाणगोचरम्
+ -निकृत a. pierced or wounded by an arrow.
an arrowshot (as a measure of distance).

a bed of arrows (बाणशष्या, शरतल्प); बाणपातान्तरे रामं पातितं
 पुरुषर्षभम्
. ˚वर्तिन् a. being within the range of an arrow.

+ -मुक्ति f., {@-मोक्षणम्@}
 discharging or shooting an arrow.
+ -रेखा a long wound made by an arrow.

+ -लिङ्गम् a white stone found in the river नर्मदा and worshipped
 as the लिङ्ग of Śiva.
+ -वारः a breast-plate, an armour, cuirass; cf. वारबाणः.

+ -संधानम् the
[]
 fitting of an arrow to the bow-string; का कथा बाणसंधाने ज्याशब्देनैव
 दूरतः Ś. 3. 1.
+ -सिद्धिः f. the hitting of a mark by an arrow.
+ -सुता an epithet of Uṣā, daughter of Bāṇa; see उषा.
